title: 10 event
description:
Visual identity system
Brand touchpoints

The events industry runs on perception. Ten Event had the capability  the identity needed to match it.
Ten Event is a Saudi-based event management and execution company. i built a brand around three qualities that define how they work: boldness, movement, and precision. The result is a dynamic identity — confident logo system, strong color palette, cohesive design language — that positions Ten Event as the standard, not just an option, in a competitive market.
